title: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Slice the beef thinly across the grain and mix with soy sauce and 1 tsp cornflour.
Cut the broccoli into florets and blanch for 2 minutes.
Sear the beef in the hot oil for 2 minutes, add the garlic and ginger, then the broccoli.
Mix the oyster sauce with the remaining cornflour and 4 tbsp water, add, let it thicken briefly and serve with sesame and rice.
